## About Parsa
Parsa Ghaei is a 17-year-old aspiring game developer from Iran. He is currently studying computer science in a technical high school, focusing on Unity and C# to create interactive experiences. He enjoys prototyping gameplay mechanics, writing Game Design Documents (GDD), and learning system design.

## Professional Focus & Skills
- **Game Engine**: Unity (Fundamentals, Master class path), C# (Gameplay scripting)
- **Tooling & Workflow**: Git, GitHub, basic Linux
- **Teamwork**: HacknPlan, Notion, Slack, Discord, MS Teams
- **Future Learning**: Unreal Engine, C++, 3D Modeling (Blender), Pixel Art
- **Long-term Goal**: Game Director by age 35+
